t: The Milwaukee Hex Shank Multi-Material Drill Bit, 8mm x 120mm, is a versatile tool for drilling into various building materials. This durable drill bit is ideal for electricians and general builders, offering reliable performance across multiple tasks. Its impact-rated design ensures compatibility with impact drivers and all 3-jaw chuck tools, including rotary and percussion drills. Featuring a tungsten-carbide-tipped construction, it drills effectively into concrete, brick, wood, and metal. The hardened material treatment enhances durability, while the white flute allows for quick identification in a busy toolbox, making it a practical choice for demanding site work.
b: Suitable for Wide Range of Building Materials, Ceramics & Tiles, Wood, Plastic, Thin Sheet Metals & Aluminium
